Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
DRAFFIN SUSPENSION APPARATUS 



1. Scope— Specifies the dimensional and other requirements for Draffln suspension apparatus 
used to hold the tongue plates over the patient's chest during throat surgery. 

2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1.

BASE PLATE 

All dimensions In millimetres. 
FIG. 1 BIPOD LEG AND BASE PLATE 

2.1 The tolerances on various dimensions, where not specified, shall be: 

a) ± 0*2 mm for dimensions up to 10*0 mm, and 

b) ±10 mm for dimensions above 10*0 mm. 

3. Materials — Stainless steel conforming to Designation 20 Cr 13 of IS : 6603-1972 'Specification 
for stainless steel bars and flats '. 

4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 Both the bipod legs shall have four rings soldered end to end in one plane with their centres 
In line with the axis of the straight leg. 

4.2 The base plate and the bipod shall be free from cracks, other tool marks and sharp edges. 

4.3 Both the legs of bipod shall be Identical to each other In all respects when examined by placing 
them on one another. 

AA The bipod legs shall be polished bright and passlvated. 

4.5 The base plate shall be straight flat bar with smooth surfaces and free from sharp edges. 

B. Heal Treatment — The bipod legs and the base plate shall be hardened and tempered to give 
a hardness of 360 to 470 HV.

I. Tiiti 

0.1 Corrosion Resistance Test — Tent the bipod legs as prescribed In IS : 7531-1075 'Method for 
boiling end autoclavlng test for corrosion resistance of stainless steel surgical instruments '. It 
shall not show any sign of corrosion after the test. 

1.2 Bend Test — Hold the bipod leg In a vice from the ring In the end of the leg horizontally. Apply 
a force of about 100 N ( 10 kgf ) vertically downwards on the free end of the leg in a gradual manner. 
Repeat the test with other leg of the bipod. The leg shall be capable of bearing this load for at 
leaet 60 eeconde without any damage or permanent eet. 

7, Marking — The bipod legs and base plate shall be marked with the manufacturer's name or 
registered trade-mark, the country of manufacture, and the words • Stainless Steel ' or the letters 
•SS'. 

7.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

S. Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier.
